rapport_notes: Genuine back-and-forth, laughs about the stand-up desk, reassures about the TV after the customer mentions a bad experience with a prior uninsured mover.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer volunteered: "my last move we didn't do our research and it wasn't insured movers and they broke the TV." Rep only replied "Oh... well, that works out perfectly then" and moved on — no follow-up on the underlying damage/trust worry.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Not delivered — no window framing, no beats-it-pay-less, no self-prep tip, no fairness check.

top_strength: Personalized the estimate range around actual item specifics (desks, TV size, disassembly needs) and clearly explained the direct-employee/'meet your movers' page.
coaching_note: Customer raised a real trust concern about a past damaged TV from an uninsured mover and it went unaddressed — this was the moment to give the $2,000 damage-coverage answer, and it never came.
